name: WebBrowserInstance
label: Web Browser Instance
description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

name: UiElement
label: UI Element
description: Select the UI element on the web page to extract data from.

name: FindType
label: Find Type
description: Specifies how to find the element (e.g., ID, XPath, CssSelector).

name: ExtractionMode
label: Extraction Mode
description: Specifies what type of data to extract (e.g., single value, list, table).

selectOptions.label: Single Value
selectOptions.description: Extracts a single text value from the web page.

selectOptions.label: Handpicked Values
selectOptions.description: Extracts manually selected values from multiple elements.

selectOptions.label: List
selectOptions.description: Extracts a list of items from repeated elements.

selectOptions.label: Table
selectOptions.description: Extracts tabular data from a web table.

selectOptions.label: Entire HTML Table
selectOptions.description: Extracts the complete HTML table structure.

name: UsePaging
label: Use Paging
description: If true, processes multiple pages by navigating through pagination.

name: GetAllWebPages
label: Get All Web Pages
description: If true, extracts data from all available pages. Otherwise, only the first page is used.

name: MaxWebPagesToProcess
label: Max Web Pages To Process
description: The maximum number of web pages to process when using 'Use Paging'.

name: PageCssSelector
label: Page CSS Selector
description: CSS selector used to locate the next page navigation element.

name: SendPhysicalClickForNextPage
label: Send Physical Click for Next Page
description: If true, simulates physical mouse click to navigate to the next page.

name: ProcessDataUponExtraction
label: Process Data Upon Extraction
description: If true, processes the data to match visual display (e.g., handles hidden elements). Not recommended for large datasets.

name: Timeout
label: Timeout Seconds
description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for an element before failing.

name: ExcelInstanceOutput
label: Excel Instance Output
description: Returns the Excel instance if storing data in Excel.

name: DataFromWebPageOutput
label: Data From Web Page Output
description: Returns the extracted data as a single value, list, data row, or data table.
